subject: ACME - SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough: proposing two evening blocks
messages:
From: Alex Romero <alex@acme-payments.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Jun 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough — availability for a short evening slot?

Hi Sean / Olga,

Thanks again for the quick intro call last week. Our security team would like to run a concise SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough focused on data flow and evidence transfer. We have limited overlap with your US-east team during our day, so evening slots are preferable.

Rough constraints from our side:
- Two 75-minute blocks would let us cover architecture, evidence transfer (SFTP/Drive), and pen-test scope questions.
- Prefer Mon-Fri between 19:00-22:00 PT (to include our London security lead).

Can Redwood offer two adjacent evening blocks (back-to-back) so we can choose one or run a long session? If so, please propose specific times and any pre-reads we should review. Attached is a short vendor intake with current network diagram.

Thanks,
Alex Romero
Security Program Manager
Acme Payments
Attachment: vendor-intake-acme-20250601.pdf (pdf stub)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough — availability for a short evening slot?

Alex — thanks, and appreciate the constraints. We can definitely do a two-block option. Two proposals below (both PT). Both are structured so we can either run one 75-min session or a back-to-back 75+45 run if you want deeper pen-test scoping.

Option A (preferred for US-east ops):
- Thu, 05 Jun 2025 — 19:00–20:15 PT (primary)
- Thu, 05 Jun 2025 — 20:30–21:15 PT (adjacent backup)

Option B (alternate evening):
- Fri, 06 Jun 2025 — 20:00–21:15 PT
- Fri, 06 Jun 2025 — 21:30–22:15 PT

What we suggest for attendees:
- Redwood: me (security handoff / high-level controls), Olga (technical evidence + SFTP), Markus Klein (pen-test scoping) — I can ask Markus to join depending on final slot.
- Acme: security lead, IT/network contact, procurement (for DPA discussion)

Pre-reads: I attached a short evidence checklist and our standard SFTP instructions. If you prefer DocSend, I can send links.

If either of these works, I’ll send a calendar hold and add a short agenda.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference

Alex — quick notes from our ops side:
- For the SFTP/secure evidence flow, please have a named point of contact and a test file ready 24 hours before the walkthrough. That keeps the session focused on scope and evidence mapping rather than transfer troubleshooting.
- If you expect to review audit logs / retention specifics, let us know and we’ll prepare the relevant exports.

Markus — can you confirm whether Thurs 5th 19:00 PT or Fri 6th 20:00 PT works for you? If neither, let us know the first three evening blocks you have free next week.

Olga

2) 19:00–19:20 PT — architecture & data flow overview
3) 19:20–19:50 PT — evidence transfer and retention Q&A (DPA specifics)
4) 19:50–20:15 PT — pen-test scoping and next steps
